improved.objective: epsilon_opt MSE, equivalent to mean(((predicted_mu-GT_discrete_posterior_mu)/c_t)^2); t uniform1..99
improved.post_warmup: cosine decay over remaining wall-clock deadline interval

both.primary_validation: same fixed 100-step native SDE, raw float RGB and same seeds; RAW and EMA
both.final_full_validation: each route EMA five strengths x Val1000; common U0 and originalFinal baseline reuse when source/protocol match
both.stop: At deadline finish in-flight optimizer update only; atomic complete save and stop updates, then final evaluation

scientific_limits: Different starting state, recipe and resources: practical two-route campaign, not a clean one-factor LR/loss ablation; small quality monitors are not success or generalization proof.
